# Shared Values & System Scoping Checklist: Custom Character Page Templates

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review gate for the 2026-09-03 amendments — shared value store (D1–D3), author-visible `valueKey`, system+kind scoping (D4), store migration v2→v3, file format v2 — before Phase 2 (data bindings) builds on them.
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [clarifications-shared-values.md](../clarifications-shared-values.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the shared value store (D1) integrated into spec.md itself, or does the normative text still live only in `clarifications-shared-values.md`? [Completeness, Gap — spec §FR-11 still names "field identifiers" as the storage key]
- [x] CHK002 - Is value-rename semantics defined: when an author changes a field's `valueKey`, is the previously stored value retained under the old key, migrated to the new key, or dropped? [Gap, Spec §FR-12]
- [x] CHK003 - Is type-conflict authority defined when two templates declare different field types for the same shared `valueKey` (e.g., text vs number)? [Gap, D1/D2]
- [x] CHK004 - Is a `valueKey` collision between a regular field and a table block's row coordinate (field key equals table block key) addressed? [Gap, D1/D2]
- [x] CHK005 - Are validation requirements for author-entered `valueKey` values defined (identifier rules, invalid-input feedback)? [Gap, D2]
- [x] CHK006 - Is editing a table block's `valueKey` covered by requirements, or are value keys editable for regular fields only? [Gap, D1]
- [x] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for how the required-field export note (FR-4a) counts a required field whose shared `valueKey` is filled through a different template's page? [Gap, Spec §FR-4a]
- [x] CHK008 - Is a measurable loss-free migration criterion added to Success Criteria for the v2→v3 flattening (e.g., zero dropped values)? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 - Do FR-11 ("keyed to the template's field identifiers") and D1 ("keyed by valueKey") agree, or does one supersede the other explicitly? [Conflict, Spec §FR-11]
- [x] CHK010 - Does FR-9 ("compatible means the same document kind") conflict with D4 compatibility = system + kind? [Conflict, Spec §FR-9 vs D4/new FR-26]
- [x] CHK011 - Is FR-12's "orphaned values" definition restated in valueKey terms (a key no active template field addresses), or do two orphan definitions coexist? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-12]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the assumption that a document belongs to exactly one system (so document-global value keys can never cross systems) stated, or implicit in the envelope model? [Assumption, D3]
- [x] CHK013 - Are catalog copy-on-select fills (FR-17) specified in valueKey coordinates — i.e., is filling a linked field that lives on a _different_ template's page a defined behavior or an unspecified side effect? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-17 vs D1]
- [x] CHK014 - Does the requirement set state one authoritative source for amendment semantics (spec.md) versus the clarification record? [Traceability, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK015 - Are requirements defined for migrating a v2 page that is only _partially_ declared by its known template (some keys orphaned at migration time)? [Coverage, Gap, D1]
- [x] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for a v2 nested page whose template is unknown at migration time (deleted before migration) and imported later with new valueKeys? [Coverage, Gap, D1]
- [x] CHK017 - Is re-assignment of a document to a different template specified as value-preserving (document-scoped values remain and become visible when a matching valueKey returns)? [Coverage, D1 vs Spec §FR-12]
- [x] CHK018 - Are import collision requirements defined for a v1 file (defaulting systemId 'star-wars-wod') colliding with an existing template of the same id under a _different_ systemId? [Coverage, Gap, D4]
- [x] CHK019 - Are rollback/recovery requirements defined for a partially applied v2→v3 migration (crash between per-document flattening steps)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [x] CHK020 - Are requirements defined for a template imported from another device whose `valueKey`s collide with unrelated local template keys on the same document? [Coverage, Gap, D3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK021 - Is behavior specified when a field's `valueKey` is set to the identifier of an existing _table block_ key in the same template (and vice versa)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK022 - Is behavior specified when two fields with an equal `valueKey` have different `required` flags — does the export note count them independently? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK023 - Is behavior specified for a multi-select field sharing a `valueKey` with a single-select field (array vs scalar value in one coordinate)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for empty-value writes to a shared coordinate (does clearing the value on one page clear it for every page reading that key)? [Edge Case, Gap, D1]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 - Can "values are never dropped during migration" be verified through a stated measurable criterion (SC-level), rather than only an implementation test? [Measurability, Gap]
- [x] CHK026 - Does any user story or acceptance scenario demonstrate the shared-value behavior (vampire case) end to end, or does it exist only in the clarification record? [Completeness, Gap — Spec §US2/US3]
- [x] CHK027 - Is SC-002 ("100% of entered values survive") restated for the flat coordinate model, including values orphaned by template switching? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 - Is the migration's dependency on template-library availability (known templates drive key mapping) documented as an ordering requirement (library hydration before document migration)? [Dependency, Gap]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the v1 file import default (`systemId: 'star-wars-wod'`) recorded as a versioned compatibility decision with its retirement condition? [Assumption, D4]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK030 - Is the term "orphaned" used consistently (field removed from template vs key not addressed by active page vs unresolvable template namespace)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-12 vs Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Do the data-model document and the spec disagree on the bag shape (nested per template vs flat), and is one marked superseded? [Conflict, data-model.md vs D1]
- [x] CHK032 - Is "page" (template assignment) vs "view" (definition-owned named view) terminology kept distinct in the amended requirements? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-9/FR-10]
